evidence: The current public LinkedIn post links this Regeneron report and describes the two-drug COURAGE regimen. The report identifies semaglutide plus trevogrumab, including the 200/400 mg arms, for adults with obesity at BMI at least 30. Its 26-week results agree with the regimen and population of the existing Phase 2 card. The article also reports a separate triplet; the attached card remains explicitly the two-drug regimen.
change: One news reference added through normal article entry. Shared address reading now unwraps LinkedIn /safety/go/ article links, preventing extension request composition from discarding them as same-site links. Safari version becomes 0.9.18. Clinical evidence, scores, summaries, statuses, post identity boundaries and condition equivalence rules remain unchanged.
efficiency: The existing withLinkedArticle path checks published source references before requesting a page or model reading. A tracked reference returns its card without a page-reader or model request.
previous_fresh_result: Release 5907850c2c5b returns NCT06299098 at 94% but no card for the freshly observed caption: its detailed condition wording differs from Obesity. This reference correction avoids treating condition strings as equivalent.
